name: Build and Test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (${{ matrix.platform }}, ${{ matrix.mode }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform:
          [
            linux-x86_64,
            linux-aarch64,
            macos-x86_64,
            macos-aarch64,
            windows-x86_64,
            windows-aarch64,
            android-aarch64,
          ]
        mode: [debug, release]
        exclude:
          - mode: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'debug' || 'release' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache and install apt packages
        uses: awalsh128/cache-apt-pkgs-action@v1
        with:
          packages: clang llvm lld make cmake ninja-build xz-utils curl unzip wget git patch python3 python-is-python3 libssl-dev lzma-dev libxml2-dev bzip2 cpio libbz2-dev zlib1g-dev bash build-essential libc6-dev-arm64-cross linux-libc-dev-arm64-cross gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu g++-aarch64-linux-gnu binutils-aarch64-linux-gnu libc6-arm64-cross
          version: v7
          execute_install_scripts: true

      - name: Fix aarch64 cross-compiler sysroot paths
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux-aarch64'
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu/usr/aarch64-linux-gnu
          sudo ln -s /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu/lib /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu/usr/aarch64-linux-gnu/lib

      - name: Test aarch64 cross-compiler
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux-aarch64'
        run: |
          echo 'int main() { return 0; }' > test.c
          /usr/bin/clang --target=aarch64-linux-gnu --sysroot=/usr/aarch64-linux-gnu -fuse-ld=lld -g -O0 test.c -o test
          echo "Cross-compiler test passed!"

      - name: Cache tsil compiler
        id: cache-tsil
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: tsil-cache
          key: tsil-${{ hashFiles('ЦІЛЬ') }}

      - name: Download and install tsil compiler tool
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "tsil-cache" ]; then
            TSIL_VERSION=$(cat ЦІЛЬ | xargs)
            URL="https://github.com/tsil-ukr/files/raw/main/випуски-цілі/${TSIL_VERSION}/ціль-${TSIL_VERSION}-лінукс-ікс86_64.tar.xz"
            curl -L "$URL" -o tsil.tar.xz
            tar -xf tsil.tar.xz
            mv "ціль-${TSIL_VERSION}-лінукс-ікс86_64" tsil-cache
            rm -rf tsil.tar.xz
          fi
          sudo cp "tsil-cache/програми/ціль" /usr/local/bin/ціль
          sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ціль

      - name: Cache llvm-mingw
        id: cache-mingw
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'windows-')
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: llvm-mingw-20260616-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64
          key: llvm-mingw-20260616-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64

      - name: Setup Windows cross-compilation (llvm-mingw)
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'windows-')
        run: |
          MINGW_DIR="llvm-mingw-20260616-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64"
          if [ ! -d "$MINGW_DIR" ]; then
            MINGW_URL="https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/download/20260616/llvm-mingw-20260616-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64.tar.xz"
            curl -L "$MINGW_URL" -o mingw.tar.xz
            tar -xf mingw.tar.xz
            rm -f mingw.tar.xz
          fi
          echo "LLVM_MINGW_PATH=$PWD/$MINGW_DIR" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Cache Android NDK
        id: cache-ndk
        if: matrix.platform == 'android-aarch64'
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: android-ndk-r27d
          key: android-ndk-r27d

      - name: Setup Android cross-compilation (NDK)
        if: matrix.platform == 'android-aarch64'
        run: |
          NDK_DIR="android-ndk-r27d"
          if [ ! -d "$NDK_DIR" ]; then
            curl -L "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/android-ndk-r27d-linux.zip" -o ndk.zip
            unzip -q ndk.zip
            rm -f ndk.zip
          fi
          echo "ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$PWD/$NDK_DIR" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Restore osxcross cache
        id: cache-osxcross-restore
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-')
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: osxcross
          key: osxcross-MacOSX14.0-v5

      - name: Setup MacOS cross-compilation (osxcross)
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-')
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "osxcross/target" ]; then
            echo "osxcross missing. Rebuilding..."
            rm -rf osxcross
            git clone https://github.com/tpoechtrager/osxcross.git
            curl -L "https://github.com/roblabla/MacOSX-SDKs/releases/download/macosx14.0/MacOSX14.0.sdk.tar.xz" \
              -o osxcross/tarballs/MacOSX14.0.sdk.tar.xz

            cd osxcross
            UNATTENDED=1 ./build.sh
            cd ..
          fi

          echo "OSXCROSS_PATH=$PWD/osxcross/target" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          SDK_DIR=$(ls -d $PWD/osxcross/target/SDK/MacOSX*.sdk | head -n 1)
          echo "CMAKE_FRAMEWORK_PATH=$SDK_DIR/System/Library/Frameworks" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CMAKE_INCLUDE_PATH=$SDK_DIR/usr/include" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Save osxcross cache
        id: cache-osxcross-save
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-') && steps.cache-osxcross-restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: osxcross
          key: ${{ steps.cache-osxcross-restore.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

      - name: Cache downloaded project libraries
        id: cache-libs
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: scripts/*.tar.gz
          key: libs-${{ hashFiles('scripts/NCURSES_VERSION', 'scripts/READLINE_VERSION', 'scripts/LIBUV_VERSION', 'scripts/OPENSSL_VERSION', 'scripts/CURL_VERSION') }}

      - name: Download project libraries
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/download_libs.sh
          bash scripts/download_libs.sh

      - name: Cache built dependencies
        id: cache-build-deps
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: build
          key: build-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-v3-${{ hashFiles('scripts/NCURSES_VERSION', 'scripts/READLINE_VERSION', 'scripts/LIBUV_VERSION', 'scripts/OPENSSL_VERSION', 'scripts/CURL_VERSION') }}

      - name: Run compilation
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build.sh
          bash scripts/build.sh \
            "${{ matrix.mode }}" \
            "${{ matrix.platform }}" || (find build -name "config.log" -exec tail -n 200 {} \; && exit 1)

      - name: Set OS artifact paths
        id: os_paths
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'windows-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'linux-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'android-')
        run: |
          VERSION=$(cat ВЕРСІЯ | xargs)
          if [ "${{ matrix.mode }}" = "release" ]; then TSIL_MODE="випуск"; else TSIL_MODE="відлагодження"; fi

          TSIL_FOLDER=""
          MAVKA_BIN="мавка"
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "linux-x86_64" ]; then TSIL_FOLDER="лінукс-ікс86_64"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "linux-aarch64" ]; then TSIL_FOLDER="лінукс-аарч64"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "macos-x86_64" ]; then TSIL_FOLDER="макос-ікс86_64"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "macos-aarch64" ]; then TSIL_FOLDER="макос-аарч64"; fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "windows-x86_64" ]; then
            TSIL_FOLDER="віндовс-ікс86_64"
            MAVKA_BIN="мавка.exe"
          fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "windows-aarch64" ]; then
            TSIL_FOLDER="віндовс-аарч64"
            MAVKA_BIN="мавка.exe"
          fi
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = "android-aarch64" ]; then
            TSIL_FOLDER="андроїд-аарч64"
          fi

          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "mode=$TSIL_MODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "folder=$TSIL_FOLDER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "bin=$MAVKA_BIN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload OS binaries
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'windows-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'linux-') || startsWith(matrix.platform, 'android-')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mavka-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: будування/${{ steps.os_paths.outputs.version }}/${{ steps.os_paths.outputs.folder }}/${{ steps.os_paths.outputs.mode }}/готове/${{ steps.os_paths.outputs.bin }}
          retention-days: 1

  check-artifacts:
    name: Check Available Artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    outputs:
      linux_matrix: ${{ steps.check.outputs.linux_matrix }}
      macos_matrix: ${{ steps.check.outputs.macos_matrix }}
      windows_matrix: ${{ steps.check.outputs.windows_matrix }}
      windows_wine_matrix: ${{ steps.check.outputs.windows_wine_matrix }}
      android_matrix: ${{ steps.check.outputs.android_matrix }}
      has_linux: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_linux }}
      has_macos: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_macos }}
      has_windows: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_windows }}
      has_windows_wine: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_windows_wine }}
      has_android: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_android }}
    steps:
      - name: Check for uploaded artifacts
        id: check
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const artifacts = await github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRunArtifacts({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              run_id: context.runId,
            });
            const names = artifacts.data.artifacts.map(a => a.name);

            const branch = context.ref.split('/').pop();
            const allowedMode = branch === 'main' ? 'release' : 'debug';

            function buildMatrix(runners) {
              let matrix = [];
              for (const [platform, runner] of Object.entries(runners)) {
                const name = `mavka-${platform}-${allowedMode}`;
                if (names.includes(name)) {
                  matrix.push({ platform: platform, mode: allowedMode, runner: runner });
                }
              }
              return matrix;
            }

            const linuxMatrix = buildMatrix({ 'linux-x86_64': 'ubuntu-latest', 'linux-aarch64': 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' });
            const macosMatrix = buildMatrix({ 'macos-x86_64': 'macos-14', 'macos-aarch64': 'macos-latest' });
            const windowsMatrix = buildMatrix({ 'windows-x86_64': 'windows-latest', 'windows-aarch64': 'windows-11-arm' });
            const androidMatrix = buildMatrix({ 'android-aarch64': 'ubuntu-latest' });

            core.setOutput('linux_matrix', JSON.stringify({ include: linuxMatrix }));
            core.setOutput('macos_matrix', JSON.stringify({ include: macosMatrix }));
            core.setOutput('windows_matrix', JSON.stringify({ include: windowsMatrix }));
            core.setOutput('android_matrix', JSON.stringify({ include: androidMatrix }));

            core.setOutput('has_linux', linuxMatrix.length > 0);
            core.setOutput('has_macos', macosMatrix.length > 0);
            core.setOutput('has_windows', windowsMatrix.length > 0);
            core.setOutput('has_android', androidMatrix.length > 0);

            // Special case for Windows Wine
            let winWineMatrix = [];
            if (names.includes(`mavka-windows-x86_64-${allowedMode}`)) {
              winWineMatrix.push({ platform: 'windows-x86_64', mode: allowedMode, runner: 'ubuntu-latest' });
            }
            core.setOutput('windows_wine_matrix', JSON.stringify({ include: winWineMatrix }));
            core.setOutput('has_windows_wine', winWineMatrix.length > 0);

  test-ubuntu:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.platform }}, ${{ matrix.mode }})
    needs: [build, check-artifacts]
    if: needs.check-artifacts.outputs.has_linux == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.check-artifacts.outputs.linux_matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Linux binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mavka-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: mavka-bin

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/test.sh
          MAVKA_PATH="$PWD/mavka-bin/мавка"
          chmod +x "$MAVKA_PATH"

          echo "Running tests using binary: $MAVKA_PATH"
          bash scripts/test.sh "$MAVKA_PATH"

  test-macos:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.platform }}, ${{ matrix.mode }})
    needs: [build, check-artifacts]
    if: needs.check-artifacts.outputs.has_macos == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.check-artifacts.outputs.macos_matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install bash (macOS)
        run: brew install bash

      - name: Download macOS binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mavka-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: mavka-bin

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          chmod +x mavka-bin/мавка
          chmod +x scripts/test.sh

          if [ -f /usr/local/bin/bash ]; then
            BASH_CMD="/usr/local/bin/bash"
          elif [ -f /opt/homebrew/bin/bash ]; then
            BASH_CMD="/opt/homebrew/bin/bash"
          else
            BASH_CMD="bash"
          fi

          echo "Running tests using binary: $PWD/mavka-bin/мавка"
          $BASH_CMD scripts/test.sh "$PWD/mavka-bin/мавка"

  test-windows-native:
    name: Test Native (${{ matrix.platform }}, ${{ matrix.mode }})
    needs: [build, check-artifacts]
    if: needs.check-artifacts.outputs.has_windows == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.check-artifacts.outputs.windows_matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Windows binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mavka-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: mavka-bin

      - name: Run tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/test.sh
          MAVKA_PATH="$PWD/mavka-bin/мавка.exe"
          chmod +x "$MAVKA_PATH"

          echo "Running tests using binary: $MAVKA_PATH"
          bash scripts/test.sh "$MAVKA_PATH"

  test-windows-wine:
    name: Test Wine (windows-x86_64, ${{ matrix.mode }})
    needs: [build, check-artifacts]
    if: needs.check-artifacts.outputs.has_windows_wine == 'true' && false
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.check-artifacts.outputs.windows_wine_matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Wine
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y wine64

      - name: Download Windows binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mavka-windows-x86_64-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: mavka-bin

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/test.sh
          MAVKA_PATH="$PWD/mavka-bin/мавка.exe"

          WINE_CMD=$(command -v wine64 || command -v wine)
          if [ -z "$WINE_CMD" ]; then
            echo "Error: Wine is not installed."
            exit 1
          fi

          WRAPPER_PATH="/tmp/mavka_wrapper"
          echo "#!/bin/bash" > $WRAPPER_PATH
          echo "$WINE_CMD \"$MAVKA_PATH\" \"\$@\"" >> $WRAPPER_PATH
          chmod +x $WRAPPER_PATH

          echo "Running tests using wrapper: $WRAPPER_PATH"
          bash scripts/test.sh "$WRAPPER_PATH"
